generation_meta_data.title: Implement CLI Factory Function String Preservation Fix
generation_meta_data.description:
Implement the fix for factory function string preservation in CLI parameter overrides. The solution involves modifying the _args_to_dictconfig function in nemo_run/cli/lazy.py to properly handle string factory functions.

Specific change needed around line 724:
- Check if current[part] is a string (factory reference)
- If so, wrap it in {"_factory_": current[part]} format
- Otherwise, convert to empty dict as before

This will enable commands like `model=my_factory model.param=value` to work correctly.
